description: Official monthly premiums of Swiss basic health insurance (KVG / LAMal) for next year, cheapest insurer first, for a municipality or postcode, an age and a franchise. Optional: model (standard, family doctor 'hausarzt', HMO, Telmed) and accident cover (employees working 8+ hours a week are usually covered by their employer and can leave it out). Data: BAG, all insurers.
